scope: Local manifest-to-publication-receipt mapping; no fresh remote object download and no new independent source/mode-integrity claim.

superseded_by.proof: Same object/member bytes and hashes; permission descriptors corrected by stripping type bits; replacement publication verified.

limitations: Publication receipts establish their recorded verification event, not current remote object availability.
A snapshot faithfully preserving a failed/rejected source bundle does not establish task acceptance or release readiness.
Superseded or incomplete snapshots remain append-only; a later correction requires an explicit evidence link.
